definitions.gloss: alcove, recessed area in traditional Japanese room
definitions.explanation: A recessed area in a Japanese-style room where art, flowers, or scrolls are displayed.

examples.japanese: {床|とこ}の{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧。
examples.english: A Japanese-style room with an alcove.

examples.japanese: {床|とこ}の{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: To display a hanging scroll in the alcove.
Flowers are arranged in the alcove.

notes:
CULTURAL SIGNIFICANCE:
The {床|とこ}の{間|ま} is a raised alcove in a traditional Japanese room (⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧), considered the spiritual and aesthetic focal point of the room.

TRADITIONAL DISPLAYS:
- ⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧: hanging scroll
- ⟦{生|い}け{花|ばな}→生け花：05409_ikebana⟧: flower arrangement
- ⟦{置物|おきもの}→置物：19885_okimono⟧: decorative objects

ETIQUETTE:
The seat of honor (⟦{上座|かみざ}→上座：11295_kamiza⟧) is closest to the {床|とこ}の{間|ま}. Guests are traditionally seated with their back to it as a sign of humility, while hosts offer the position facing it.

Note: Modern homes rarely have {床|とこ}の{間|ま}, but they remain important in traditional inns (⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧) and tea rooms.
